blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

acceptance_requirements: Preserve the frozen milestone requirement for three traversable maps and the full R02 movement, camera, facing, and equipment presentation contract. This increment alone does not complete either requirement.
Preserve the verified MAP01 bridge route, Space jump, WASD movement, mouse look, Tab shoulder switch, Escape release and click recapture, native Godot project validity, and host boot.
Judge new behavior from ordinary input, candidate-bound runtime state, logs, and shipped-camera frames. Source files and asset metadata are supporting evidence only.
deferred_items: MAP03, both complete chapter boundaries, story-based entry conditions, and the full three-map journey remain mandatory work after this increment.
Dodge or roll, automatic step traversal, coherent locomotion poses, and equipment presentation remain mandatory R02 work after this increment.
The frozen milestone review remains open until its playable teaching, progression, save, and reload journey is independently verified.
implied_completion: A new map contributes spatial progress only when its actual bound runtime scene can be traversed at player scale with readable landmarks, collision, and a return path.
A sprint contributes R02 progress only when physical Shift input changes ordinary movement speed and release returns to walking without breaking jump, facing, or camera control.
The four allocated issue records remain individually open unless independent evidence demonstrates each issue's full acceptance outcome.
mandatory_objectives: Advance the pinned missing-maps blocker by creating and validating one distinct MAP02 meadow traversal space.
Make one independently measurable R02 advance through physical-input sprint.
Reproduce and report the allocated camera and face defects against the current candidate; make only a bounded repair supported by a discriminating cause and adjacent visual checks.
task_specification.objective: Establish a player-scale MAP02 meadow route and a measurable sprint response while preserving the verified MAP01 and jump behavior and retaining full milestone acceptance.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate's main scene instantiates MAP01 only; there is no MAP02 or MAP03 scene or chapter transition. The player controller has a working jump but no sprint action. Prior live views also reproduce wall-contact camera cropping and a face plate that appears separate from the ranger hood. The completeness and suitability of available meadow assets remain unverified.

stop_conditions: Do not report the three-map issue, full R02 criterion, or milestone review as passed from this two-condition increment.
If MAP02 cannot be observed in a candidate-bound runtime session, report its route outcome as insufficient evidence even if the scene imports.
If physical input, state sampling, or shipped-camera capture is unavailable, leave the affected outcome unverified and identify the missing Host observation.
Keep camera cropping and face integration open when the required shoulder, front, or side views still show their reported defects.

strategy.rationale: The prior loop extended MAP01 and added jump while the missing-map and action findings persisted. This loop probes scene assembly and binding, adds a distinct MAP02 space, and measures one absent action. It respects the host limit of two new observable completion conditions.

code: Check Godot scene and script import, physical Shift binding, native project validity, and host boot.
Inspect the bound MAP02 scene and asset provenance; a source declaration or successful import does not establish player traversal.
runtime: Host and Tester traverse MAP02 from safe entry to cover clearing, boundary, and back using ordinary movement, pairing frames with position, floor, and collision state.
Compare W-only and physical Shift plus W over matched intervals, then release Shift and confirm the return to walking.

Retest MAP01 bridge traversal, physical Space takeoff and landing, mouse look, Tab, Escape, and click recapture. Run the frozen full milestone and R02 reviews without treating partial progress as a pass.
visual: Capture MAP02 entry, route middle, cover clearing, boundary, and return through the shipped camera, checking scale, route readability, and material quality.
Capture the MAP01 south-wall contact on both shoulders and ranger front and side views; compare each with the reported camera and face defects.

done_when: In a candidate-bound runtime launch of MAP02, ordinary movement takes Aelor from a safe meadow entry along a recognizable farm-and-treeline route to a usable cover or encounter clearing and back; entry, clearing, boundary, and return frames plus position and collision observations show the route is traversable at character scale.

On the shipped player route, holding physical Shift with W produces a sustained speed greater than the same W-only walk; releasing Shift returns to walk speed, with matching position and velocity samples and start, movement, and release frames.
tasks.instructions: Use frozen PRD §§3.1, 5.1, 5.3, 8.1, 10.2 and R01/R02. Inspect the current candidate and the selected meadow resources before placing a route. Compare bounded local candidates with external candidates only under Developer authority; distinguish a complete authored environment from a modular kit, and qualify provenance, license, geometry, materials, texture scale, import, and actual runtime binding. Keep MAP02 visibly distinct and consistent with the mature character and environment scale. For any newly composed visible asset families, record the policy's family ID, style match, source quality, materials and textures, measured use counts, source and runtime variant counts, maximum variant share, diversity axes, background mode, and representative runtime views; apply the complete-environment exception only if a qualified package actually supplies the layout and composition. Consult registered Godot documentation for the chosen movement, collision, scene-loading, and visible-environment capabilities in the installed renderer. Preserve the prior working controls. Reproduce wall-contact views on both shoulders and ranger front and side views; investigate instance, binding, or replacement causes before any further transform adjustment, and report remaining defects separately. Do not bypass the PRD's chapter-entry conditions to claim an ordinary three-map journey. Keep the full gap open until all R02 behavior is independently measured.

investigation.expected_observation: The running project references MAP01 only. A suitable MAP02 source will either supply a complete player-scale route or require deliberate composition and collision work; a title or preview will not establish traversability.
investigation.hypothesis: The repeated missing-map finding persists because the running scene assembly contains only MAP01, rather than because an existing MAP02 fails at a doorway.
investigation.probe: Inspect the main scene's bound instances and the bounded meadow shortlist, then launch the selected MAP02 scene at character scale and walk from entry to cover clearing, boundary, and return while sampling player state and shipped-camera frames.

research_assessment.reason: The indexed meadow resource is not proven to be a complete map, and the current candidate contains no MAP02 binding. Sprint, camera framing, and character-scale appearance require live observation. Planner network access is disabled; Developer should compare external candidates only if its existing authority permits it

risk_note.why_now: The oldest major blocker remains the absence of two maps, and the prior MAP01 expansion left that root cause unchanged.
